data.name: Sharwanand
data.long_meaning: Sharwanand is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'sharas' (quencher of desire) and 'anand' (bliss). It refers to the Hindu deity Shiva, who is believed to grant the desires of his devotees, hence the name 'Lord of the Quencher's Desire'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the granting of desires and the attainment of spiritual bliss through devotion to Shiva.
